description: The biggest price gainers and losers over a window, among tokens with enough pool liquidity to be tradeable. Both lists are returned together.

limit.description: How many tokens per list to return (1-25, default 10).

minLiquidityAda.description: Leave out tokens with less pool liquidity than this many ADA (default 10,000; 0 = none).

name: get_market_movers
title: Biggest gainers and losers
